# czc-v2026.10.23.1 (0.2.17.24)

Grok chat streams that the gateway has to cut now end as a finished turn, so
Kilo and other OpenAI-compatible clients stop on their own instead of
spinning or reporting `ECONNRESET`. That covers the 58-minute xhigh limit and
service restarts during deploys.

## Changes since czc-v2026.10.22.6

### Grok chat: aborted streams end as a finished turn

- When the gateway cuts a Grok `/v1/chat/completions` stream, it used to write
  an SSE `error` frame. Kilo does not treat that frame as the end of the turn,
  so a Grok xhigh session that hit the 58-minute limit kept spinning until the
  user stopped it (one session on 2026-10-22 ran 59 minutes). The stream now
  ends with:
  - an assistant content chunk with the reason in plain words;
  - a chunk with `finish_reason`: `length` for the 58-minute deadline
    (`grok_reasoning_deadline`) and the context fuse
    (`grok_reasoning_window`), `stop` for an idle upstream
    (`grok_stream_idle`) or an upstream cut
    (`grok_reasoning_upstream_cut`);
  - `data: [DONE]`.
- The response is marked committed, so the handler no longer appends an
  `event: error` frame after `[DONE]`.
- The reasoning of that turn is still lost; the upstream never produced an
  answer. Thresholds are unchanged.

### Deploy restarts no longer cut Grok streams with ECONNRESET

- Shutdown gave in-flight requests 5 seconds and then dropped them. Grok
  xhigh streams run for tens of minutes, so every deploy cut the ones in
  progress and Kilo reported `Connection reset by server` / `ECONNRESET`
  (2026-10-22 09:49:16 and 13:48:48, matching the 22.2 and 22.3 restarts).
- The server now signals a drain before `Shutdown`. A running Grok chat
  stream that has already sent output ends with a terminal chunk
  (`Gateway restarted and interrupted this Grok turn; please resend`,
  `finish_reason: stop`) and `[DONE]`. One that has not sent output yet
  returns an ordinary error. The 5-second shutdown window is unchanged.
- Other streams are unchanged by this release.

### Repository

- `deploy/devin-tool-sanitize/proxy.py` and its README now match the copy
  that has been running at `~/.local/opt/devin-tool-sanitize/proxy.py`
  (rewrite of the Cline/Kilo identity sentence that Devin swe-2 flags as
  `permission_denied`, a minimal system prompt when the client omits one,
  optional response dumps). No runtime change.

## VERSION

`0.2.17.24`

## Upgrade guidance

Drop-in, no database migration and no configuration change.

This deploy itself restarts the old 0.2.17.23 process, which does not have the
drain yet, so a Grok stream running at that moment can still be cut once.
Restarts after this release end Grok streams cleanly.

## Compatibility

- Clients that parsed the old SSE `error` frame codes
  (`grok_reasoning_deadline`, `grok_reasoning_window`, `grok_stream_idle`,
  `grok_reasoning_upstream_cut`) on Grok chat streams now get a normal
  assistant message and `finish_reason` instead. The codes remain in the
  gateway logs and ops records.

## Verification

Passed:

- `gofmt -l` on the changed Go files: clean.
- `go vet ./cmd/server ./internal/service`, `go build ./...`.
- `go test -count=1 ./...`: 52/52 packages with tests pass, 0 failed.
- `-tags unit ./internal/service`: the only failures are the 12 that also
  fail on unmodified `dev-czc` (listed in the czc-v2026.10.22.2 notes).
- New or updated tests (`grok_chat_stream_test.go`, `unit` tag): terminal
  chunks and `finish_reason` per abort code; idle, upstream-cut and
  window-fuse streams end with content + `finish_reason` + `[DONE]` and no
  `error`; the window-fuse response is marked committed; a running stream
  drained mid-reasoning ends within seconds with the restart message and is
  committed; `BeginGatewayDrain` is idempotent.

Failed or skipped:

- `go test -race` reports a data race in the existing

- Frontend source is unchanged; it was rebuilt only for the embed build.

## Rollback

Redeploy `czc-v2026.10.22.6`, or restore the backup
`/opt/sub2api/sub2api.bak.czc-v2026.10.23.1-<UTC timestamp>` created during
this deploy and restart `sub2api.service`.
